name: 31-boot-night-silent-confirms
incident: cam-C T20 and cam-B T23, 2026-10-03: day->night pair after every timpsd start at night
description: A dark room, the camera restarted at night (cut filter open, illuminator on). The night pipeline reads 2498 - between day_gain 768 and night_gain 4096 - and no night reference exists yet. The boot measurement used to answer by switching to the day pipeline (IR-cut click, colour flash), read 3587 there and switch straight back: a visible day->night pair on every start. It now asks the cheap question first: one silent probe, illuminator off, no click. Without the LEDs the scene reads 10000 (r = 4), so the illuminator carries it and night is confirmed with nothing switched; the lit level anchors the night reference. The click budget of 0 is the proof: the old behaviour spends 2 here. A boot that is NOT a clean night (lit room, unusable ratio) still ends in the audible day probe - scenarios 02, 04, 07, 09 and 16 keep covering that path.

expect_log: boot: night confirmed by the silent probe
forbid_log: silent measurement is not a clean night
